title: Exactness on degree-zero away-localized charts
statement: Let k be a field and S=k[x_0,x_1] with the standard total-degree grading S_n. For j=0,1,2 let M_j be an S-module with an internal direct sum decomposition into additive subgroups M_{j,z}, indexed by all integers, satisfying S_n M_{j,z} ⊆ M_{j,n+z}. Let φ:M_0→M_1 and ψ:M_1→M_2 be S-linear degree-preserving maps with φ injective, image(φ)=kernel(ψ), and ψ surjective. Let f∈S_d with d>0. Let A_j be additive abelian groups and α_j:A_j→M_j[f^{-1}] injective additive maps whose images are exactly the equal-degree fractions [def-sc-degree-zero-module-fractions], with denominators in the powers of f. Let i:A_0→A_1 and q:A_1→A_2 be additive maps such that α_0(s)=y/f^m implies α_1(i(s))=φ(y)/f^m, and α_1(t)=y/f^m implies α_2(q(t))=ψ(y)/f^m, for every nonnegative m and every numerator. Then i is injective, image(i)=kernel(q), and q is surjective.

proof.text: Define the ordinary localized maps F and G at powers of f. Apply [lem-sc-p1-localization-short-exact] (IsLocalizedModule.map_injective, map_exact, map_surjective) to obtain their injectivity, exactness and surjectivity.

proof.text: Every localized element has a fraction representative, and every denominator in the powers of f is f^m. The hypotheses hi and hq and the map_LocalizedModules formula therefore give F(alpha_0(s))=alpha_1(i(s)) and G(alpha_1(t))=alpha_2(q(t)) for all s and t.

source.place: Lemma 01M7 (lemma-proj-sheaves), final functoriality paragraph; Algebra Section 00JM, homogeneous localization

proof.text: Injectivity of F and alpha_0 gives injectivity of i. If q(s)=0, ordinary localized exactness gives a preimage of alpha_1(s) under F. Apply [lem-sc-p1-away-degreezero-lift] to choose a preimage among the equal-degree fractions [def-sc-degree-zero-module-fractions]. The prescribed range of alpha_0 lifts this fraction to t in A_0, and injectivity of alpha_1 gives i(t)=s. Conversely G(F(x))=0 from ordinary exactness implies q(i(t))=0 by injectivity of alpha_2.

source.place: Lemma 01M7 (lemma-proj-sheaves), final functoriality paragraph; Algebra Section 00JM, homogeneous localization

proof.text: Given s in A_2, surjectivity of G gives an ordinary localized preimage of alpha_2(s). Apply [lem-sc-p1-away-degreezero-lift] for psi to obtain an equal-degree preimage. The range of alpha_1 gives t in A_1; commutativity and injectivity of alpha_2 give q(t)=s.

theorem proj_away_degreeZero_exact
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (M : Fin 3 → Type u) [∀ j, AddCommGroup (M j)]
    [∀ j, Module (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (M j)]
    (𝓜 : ∀ j, ℤ → AddSubgroup (M j))
    (h𝓜 : ∀ j, DirectSum.IsInternal (𝓜 j))
    (hsmul : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) (z : ℤ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (y : M j),
      a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n → y ∈ 𝓜 j z → a • y ∈ 𝓜 j (n + z))
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
    (A : Fin 3 → Type u) [∀ j, AddCommGroup (A j)]
    (alpha : ∀ j, A j →+ LocalizedModule.Away f (M j))
    (halpha : ∀ j, Function.Injective (alpha j) ∧
      Set.range (alpha j) = degreeZeroFractions
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)))
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝓜 j n : Set (M j))) (Submonoid.powers f))
    (phi : M 0 →ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k] M 1)
    (psi : M 1 →ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k] M 2)
    (hphi : ∀ (z : ℤ) (y : M 0), y ∈ 𝓜 0 z → phi y ∈ 𝓜 1 z)
    (hpsi : ∀ (z : ℤ) (y : M 1), y ∈ 𝓜 1 z → psi y ∈ 𝓜 2 z)
    (hinj : Function.Injective phi) (hexact : Function.Exact phi psi)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective psi)
    (i : A 0 →+ A 1) (q : A 1 →+ A 2)
    (hi : ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : M 0) (s : A 0),
      alpha 0 s = mk y (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f) →
      alpha 1 (i s) = mk (phi y) (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f))
    (hq : ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : M 1) (s : A 1),
      alpha 1 s = mk y (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f) →
      alpha 2 (q s) = mk (psi y) (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f)) :
    Function.Injective i ∧ Function.Exact i q ∧ Function.Surjective q
